# drawbridge — adult sites the public list misses
#
# Always on, no option behind it, pinned by SHA-256 in dist/policy.json.
#
# The `adult` source is the Block List Project's porn.txt, maintained by others
# and downloaded at refresh time. This file sits beside it for what that list
# does not carry, so a site can be blocked the day it is found rather than the
# day somebody upstream adds it. It adds to the public list and never replaces it.
#
# Add a domain here only once it has been opened and shown to carry porn; say
# what it is on the line above, so the next reader need not fetch it again.

# Telegram directories that carry porn and AI companions.
nsfwtelegram.net
bestoftelegram.com
